name: San Ling Yi Shi Wu Yiren
source:
Banter Schooldays!! is a visual novel legal drama adventure game developed by the independent  team Lingtan Studio. 

Use logic and debate to dive deep into the perils of traditional Chinese education, and build a chain of evidence to break through beautiful lies. Uncover lying classmates, unqualified teachers, and brutal parents. Break the educational shackles that clamp down on students.

Campus court hearings are here!
